348:t_000:75.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Maybe it's because you helped me become more positive, $n...」

348:t_000:76.en:
$n
「If that's the case, then that's fine with me.」

348:t_000:77.en:
$$カトル$$
「...Everyone, be careful. Something is approaching us...!」

348:t_000:78.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「If anyone's coming to a place like this, they must be up to no good.」

348:t_001:1.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「That brat is already gone, so the name hardly suits us anymore.」

348:t_001:2.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「But the ideals we held back then still live on in our hearts.」

348:t_001:4.en:
$$五飛$$
「So these guys didn't surrender to $$ネオ・ジオン$$ or the Federation. They're still fighting under $$デキム・バートン$$'s ideology?」

348:t_001:5.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「Exactly! The $$地球連邦$$, already half collapsed, can't stop us!」

348:t_001:6.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「We won't rely on $$ネオ・ジオン$$ either. We'll build a new independent nation here on Mars!」

348:t_001:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Do you understand the situation you're in?」

348:t_001:9.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「That day, in the battle of Brussels, we were robbed of our pride in creating a new world!」

348:t_001:10.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「To take that pride back, we have no choice but to win!」

348:t_001:11.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「And to do that, we'll seize the Mars settlements and make this planet ours!」

348:t_001:12.en:
$$五飛$$
「Winners and losers again...? Why can't they ever escape that...!」

348:t_001:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I know. I won't let people who mistake ego for pride do as they please with this new land!」

348:t_001:16.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「$c...! Having you here was a miscalculation, but it looks like your forces have been worn down!」

348:t_001:17.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「We'll settle our debt with you too!」

348:t_001:20.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If that will satisfy you, I'll fight you.」

348:t_001:21.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, begin the attack! We'll wipe out $$デキム・バートン$$'s ambition here, completely!」

348:t_002:0.en:
$$モーム$$
「Everyone, be careful! Enemy reinforcements are coming!」

348:t_002:1.en:
$$桂$$
「You're persistent, you bunch of sore losers holding a grudge!」

348:t_003:0.en:
$$カトル$$
「To think such a large force has come...!」

348:t_003:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Looks like the remnants of $$マリーメイア$$'s army from the $$地球圏$$ have gathered on Mars!」

348:t_005:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$アン・アーレス$$! Is that $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$!?」

348:t_005:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What the... You're still wasting time on small fry?」

348:t_005:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Well... I only came to play, while I was here on other business.」

348:t_005:3.en:
$$五飛$$
「So it was you who showed the $$マリーメイア$$ Army the way here!」

348:t_005:4.en:
$$カレン$$
「You amplified those people's hatred and made them do this...!」

348:t_005:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't get the wrong idea, Earthling. It's true the $$サイデリアル$$ brought them all the way here, but...」

348:t_005:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Their hatred is entirely their own.」

348:t_005:8.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's just what humans are. The emotion of hatred is carved into the heart deeper than anything else.」

348:t_005:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Love is something that either gets fulfilled one day and loses its value, or rots away without ever reaching anyone... But hatred is eternal.」

348:t_005:10.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Even if you kill its target or wipe it out, once hatred is born it clings to the bottom of the heart and stays with that person forever.」

348:t_005:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You understand, don't you, $$ゼロ$$! And you too, $$いがみ合う双子$$!」

348:t_005:14.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Hatred clings to the bottom of your hearts...! You've kept it under control so far, but one day it will...」

348:t_005:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Silence, $$バルビエル$$! I have no intention of listening to your words!」

348:t_005:16.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...Fine. But you can never win.」

348:t_005:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Those men, whose hatred grew from defeat, will swallow you up!」

348:t_005:18.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「All units, charge! The momentum is ours!」

348:t_005:19.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ are behind us! Though $c's morale isn't high!」

348:t_005:20.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「This is bad, $$ゼロ$$. Facing both them and $$バルビエル$$ is dangerous.」

348:t_005:21.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But retreating won't change the situation. We'll act as a shield for the settlement and...」

348:t_005:22.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「There's no need to worry about that...!」

348:t_006:2.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「You lawless scum, spreading hatred without ever reflecting on your own folly!」

348:t_006:3.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「What you're trying to do has no justice to uphold and no pride to protect!」

348:t_006:4.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「All you have is petty ego!」

348:t_006:5.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「You dare say that to us...!」

348:t_006:6.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「When it comes down to it, you're losers who wagged your tails at the regime after being defeated!」

348:t_006:7.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「That's right! We are shameless wretches who pinned our guilt on Her Highness and lived on without a care!」

348:t_006:8.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We have no justice or pride left! We will only devote our lives to the future of the people Her Highness staked her own life to protect!」

348:t_006:9.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Come on! We'll show you the resolve to fight to the death that we inherited from Her Highness!」

348:t_006:10.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「$c! Leave them to us, and defeat the $$サイデリアル$$!!」

348:t_006:11.en:
$$マリーメイア兵$$
「All units, charge! Break through $c and crush those losers!」

348:t_007:1.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「This red land is our future!」

348:t_008:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Men with something to protect won't lose that easily.」

348:t_008:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If you're worried, let's finish off the $$サイデリアル$$ quickly and go to their aid.」

348:t_008:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Did you see, $$バルビエル$$! There are people who don't lose to hatred and can stake their lives on what they must do!」

348:t_008:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Don't think the words of someone who lost to hatred, like you, can move our hearts!」
